quote.text: 「你是台灣人，你頭戴台灣天，腳踏台灣地，眼睛所看見的是台灣的狀況，耳孔所聽見的是台灣的消息，時間所歷的亦是台灣的經驗，嘴裡所說的亦是台灣的語言。」
quote.style: reading aloud a declaration from an old newspaper, each word clear and firm

paragraphs.style: a light, lively narrator, moving along quickly
a narrator with quiet pride, lifted and bright but not exaggerated
a quiet, soft narrator, painting a picture, unhurried
a grave narrator, slow and heavy, leaving space at the end
